adversarial_audit.objection: The isotypic measurement cannot flatten the average frame.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Only if its label is discarded: equation (1) then removes it. The coherent-tagged channel is equation (2), and two exact W4 controls show a strict conditioned improvement.

adversarial_audit.objection: Any decrease in the raw top eigenvalue is progress.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Postselection divides by retained probability. All discarded-label decreases are too small; coherent tagging produces only two finite conditioned improvements.

adversarial_audit.objection: Finite norm preservation proves an asymptotic no-go.
adversarial_audit.resolution: It does not. At large n the selected filter may remove a spectrally sparse obstruction while retaining probability 1-o(1).
Their formal sieve combines two states and retains irrep-name transcripts. This filter globally resolves orientation multiplicity data, so a direct reduction to that model is absent.

claim_gate.reason: Discarding the isotypic label is exactly a principal compression and gives no finite conditioned gain. Coherent label retention gives two W4 gains, but no all-n tagged-sector norm theorem, decoder, or classical separation exists.

falsifiers_triggered: Discarding the diagonal isotypic label does not independently flatten the average frame; coherently retaining it can.
Raw filtered-frame norm is preserved in 45 of 51 complete collision-free W4/W5 controls.
All discarded-label raw reductions disappear after postselection normalization, while coherent tagging retains two strict finite gains.

summary: Separated discarded-label principal compression from the intended coherent-tagged frame, proved both identities, and found 11 finite conditioned W4/W5 gains but no asymptotic sector bound.

theorem_contract.asymptotic_boundary: A viable theorem must upper-bound the count and magnitude of post-common-core spectral spikes on typical natural tuples.
theorem_contract.average_frame_identity: sum_nu K_nu B K_nu^*=Z_H U_H B U_H^* Z_H.
theorem_contract.coherent_tagged_frame: B_tag=direct_sum_nu Z_H U_H Pi_nu B Pi_nu U_H^* Z_H; its norm is the maximum sector norm and is at most the discarded-label compression norm.
theorem_contract.commutation: [B,Pi_nu]=0 for every diagonal S_n isotypic projector.
theorem_contract.conditioning: Equal hidden-label acceptance p makes the normalized output frame top equal to raw_filtered_top/p; raw reduction alone is not algorithmic progress.
theorem_contract.equality_criterion: The raw top norm is preserved iff the top eigenspace of B intersects Ran(U_H^* Z_H).
theorem_contract.interlacing: If q=rank(I-Z_H), then filtered top >= lambda_(q+1)(B).
theorem_contract.measurement_consequence: Discarding nu supplies no average-frame spectral advantage. Retaining nu coherently produces orthogonal output blocks and can strictly lower the frame norm.
theorem_contract.rank_budget: For dim(H)=r, the filter rejects exactly a 2^-r Hilbert-space fraction and can remove at most that many top spectral directions.
